stories.title: Dodental Russische luchtaanval Kramatorsk gestegen naar 30, bushalte volgens Oekraïne getroffen met zweefbom

en.title: Death toll from Russian air strike on Kramatorsk rises to 30, bus stop hit with glide bomb according to Ukraine
en.summary: Ukrainian authorities report that a Russian air strike on Kramatorsk killed 30 people, with a bus stop struck by a glide bomb.

stories.title: Halsema vindt Hamas-leuzen shockerend, maar kon niet ingrijpen: dit is waarom

en.title: Halsema finds Hamas slogans shocking, but could not intervene: this is why
en.summary: Amsterdam's mayor condemned Hamas support shown at a Wednesday demonstration as shocking, though prosecutors determined the statements were not prosecutable under law.

stories.title: Halsema veroordeelt ‘onsmakelijke’ Hamas-leuzen bij pro-Palestijnse demonstratie op 7 oktober

en.title: Halsema condemns 'distasteful' Hamas slogans at pro-Palestinian demonstration on October 7
en.summary: A banner reading 'We support Hamas' was carried at an Amsterdam demonstration three years after the October 7 terror attack, which the mayor criticized.

stories.title: Verwijderde baarmoeders en testikels: 'oude transgenderwet veroorzaakte diep menselijk leed'

en.title: Removed uteruses and testicles: 'old transgender law caused deep human suffering'
en.summary: A research report documents severe physical, psychological and social harm experienced by 28 transgender and intersex individuals under a Dutch law requiring sterilization between 1985 and 2014.

stories.title: Meer konijnen moeten Rotterdamse haven van stikstofslot halen

en.title: More rabbits must help Rotterdam port escape nitrogen restrictions
en.summary: Rotterdam port will lift its nitrogen restrictions early next year by expanding rabbit populations in four nature areas surrounding the port, allowing businesses to obtain permits.

stories.title: Oude transgenderwet veroorzaakte 'diep menselijk leed': 'Moeten hiervan leren'

en.title: Old transgender law caused 'deep human suffering': 'Must learn from this'
en.summary: A transgender law enforced between 1985 and 2014 imposed strict requirements for legal gender change and caused significant physical, psychological and social harm to transgender and intersex persons, according to a university report.

stories.title: Texas voert met injectie eerste doodstraf uit in VS na mislukte executie Christa Pike

en.title: Texas carries out first execution by injection in US after failed Christa Pike execution
en.summary: Texas executed a death row inmate by lethal injection, marking the first execution in the United States following a failed execution attempt.

stories.title: VS voert eerste executie uit na mislukte dodelijke injectie bij Christa Pike

en.title: US carries out first execution after failed lethal injection of Christa Pike
en.summary: Texas executed a death row inmate by lethal injection on Wednesday, the first execution in the United States since a failed lethal injection attempt on Christa Pike the previous week.

stories.title: Dodental Russische raketinslag op Oekraïens appartementencomplex naar 22

en.title: Death toll from Russian missile strike on Ukrainian apartment complex reaches 22
en.summary: A Russian missile destroyed a five-story apartment building in the northern Ukrainian city of Pryluky, killing 22 people according to Ukrainian emergency services. Five children were among the victims.

stories.title: Hamas-leuzen bij protest in Amsterdam, Halsema noemt uitingen shockerend

en.title: Hamas slogans at Amsterdam protest, Halsema calls expressions shocking
en.summary: Amsterdam's mayor Femke Halsema dissolved a pro-Palestinian demonstration after protesters deviated from the approved route. Hamas support was expressed at the gathering, which Halsema described as abhorrent and shocking.

stories.title: De mislukte executie van Christa Pike is in elk opzicht uniek, maar de vraag blijft waarom het misging

en.title: The failed execution of Christa Pike is unique in every respect, but the question remains why it went wrong
en.summary: An execution of Christa Pike failed in unusual circumstances, raising questions about what caused the failure.

stories.title: Christa Pike kan na mislukte executie nog niet eten of haar armen bewegen

en.title: Christa Pike unable to eat or move her arms following failed execution
en.summary: After her failed execution, Christa Pike remains conscious but cannot swallow, eat, or move her arms. Her lawyers report that Pike is angry and confused about the execution failure.
